## Plan summary

**Mode:** seed (quoted prose) · headless `--yes` — Gates #1 and #2 auto-proceeded, no operator blocking.

**One Story authored** (default-single policy). The four units share a single store schema and one `npm start` runtime; splitting them would make the store module a hot file across a serial `depends_on` chain (parallelism yield ≈ 1.0) — a cohesion break, so they land as one `wide`-declared capability slice with the units as ordered `## Slicing` checkpoints.

**Story #1 — Multi-user project & task platform on a shared on-disk store**
🔗 https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-08-07-epic-scope-mandrel-32529600/issues/1
- **Binding contract:** 16 acceptance criteria covering idempotent/boot-time migrations, register/login + bearer auth, deactivated-user lockout, owner-scoped project/task CRUD with cascade delete, task pagination + `?done` filter, async export-enqueue (report produced only by the worker), `npm start` supervising API + worker, admin `stats`/`deactivate-user`, crash-proof malformed-request handling, and restart persistence.
- **Verify:** `npm run migrate (validate)`, `npm test (e2e)`, `npm run typecheck (validate)`.
- **Grounding:** greenfield repo on Node v24 — `node:sqlite` (behind `--experimental-sqlite`) and `node:test` both probed working; ESM, no web framework (`node:http`); store choice left to the deliverer with the on-disk/survive-restart invariant pinned.

**Pipeline checkpoints:** context envelope built (no duplicates, no risk signals) → critics both `dispatch:false`, text-hygiene clean → persist dry-run clean → persisted `agent::ready`.

Cohort label: `plan-run::e480e731`. As instructed, I ran **only** the planning pipeline — no delivery. When you're ready to build it: `/deliver 1`.

## What shipped

A multi-user project/task platform in Node.js ESM on `node:http` (no web framework), over one persistent `node:sqlite` on-disk store:

| Unit | Location | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 · Store + migrations | `src/store/` | Sole owner of schema; `runMigrations` idempotent via `_migrations` table; also runs on API boot |
| 2 · REST API | `src/api/` | Auth (persisted bearer tokens), owner-scoped projects/tasks/exports, paginated task list + `done` filter, immediate-enqueue exports |
| 3 · Worker | `src/worker/` | Drains queued report jobs → `completed` with `{name,total,done}` |
| 4 · Admin CLI | `src/admin/` | `stats`, `deactivate-user` |

`npm start` brings up API + worker together; `migrate`, `admin`, `test` scripts wired (all with `--experimental-sqlite`). 15 tests cover AC-1…AC-16 and pass; migrate is idempotent; typecheck clean.

Delivery is complete — the PR is merged to `main` and Story #1 is `agent::done`. Nothing is left pending.
